name: week
title: The capacity meeting
subtitle: Next 28 calendar days. Confirmed and tentative work remain separate.

sections.title: Weekly capacity
sections.sql: select name,role,week,capacity_hours,confirmed_hours,tentative_hours,free_hours,worst_day_free_hours from resource_week order by week,name

sections.title: Days that do not fit
sections.sql: select name,work_date,capacity_hours,confirmed_hours,free_hours from capacity_next_month where free_hours<0 order by work_date,name

sections.title: Staffing requests
sections.sql: select project,role,skill,start_on,end_on,daily_hours,owner,status from request_queue order by start_on

sections.title: Hours against the plan
sections.sql: select name,budget_hours,planned_hours,planned_to_date,actual_to_date,budget_remaining from project_totals order by name

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select rule,subject,finding from record_checks order by rule,subject
